description: Predefined domain knowledge & signal weights for GigSphere Trust & Fraud Detection Engine

duplicate_profile_text.description: Profile summary or bio matches another registered account above similarity threshold

suspicious_profile_image.description: Profile image pattern flagged as generic placeholder or stock asset

incomplete_profile.description: Missing key professional details such as bio, skills, or portfolio

skills_portfolio_mismatch.description: Prominent claimed skills are completely unsupported by portfolio or past deliverables

unusual_proposal_frequency.description: Abnormally high proposal submission rate without project engagement

repeated_contract_cancellations.description: High percentage of started contracts cancelled or abandoned before milestone delivery

payment_disputes.description: Escrow or payment disputes raised against freelancer deliverables

unusual_messaging_pattern.description: Detected off-platform communication invitations or suspicious keywords

incomplete_company_profile.description: Client account has unverified company and minimal profile details

repeated_posting_without_hiring.description: Multiple project postings created and closed without hiring any applicant

repeated_project_cancellations.description: High frequency of contract cancellations initiated by client

unrealistic_budget_pattern.description: Project budget is significantly disconnected from required scope and deliverable complexity

frequent_payment_disputes.description: Repeated payment clawbacks or milestone escrow disputes logged against client

off_platform_payment_attempt.description: Pattern of attempting to direct payments outside platform escrow system

kyc_verified.description: Account identity and documentation officially verified

high_completion_rate.description: Consistent 90%+ contract and milestone completion track record

top_rated_reviews.description: Sustained high rating (4.8+) across multiple unique client engagements

verified_company.description: Corporate client with verified tax/GSTIN credentials

established_escrow_history.description: Punctual escrow releases without dispute history
